name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey in motorsport began in his youth, captivated by the roar of engines at Suzuka Circuit. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, quickly finding his niche in race car development. His early career was spent fine-tuning suspension systems and aerodynamic packages for smaller racing teams. Kenji steadily climbed the ranks, known for his meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of marginal gains.

He joined Reiza Racing Academy a decade ago, bringing his extensive experience to nurture the next generation of engineers and drivers. While demanding, Kenji is respected for his ability to extract the best from his team. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making and a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. His distinctive approach lies in blending traditional engineering principles with cutting-edge simulation techniques, ensuring Reiza stays ahead of the curve.

Kenji's mentorship extends beyond technical expertise. He instills a strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence in his team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement. His legacy at Reiza is shaping the future of motorsport, one engineer and one race at a time.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Kenji is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Insists on drinking green tea precisely at 3:00 PM every day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
